name: Syncthing
summary: Keeps the same folders on all your devices, with no cloud and no storage limit.
gains: No storage limit except your own drives
tradeoffs: Not a backup by itself, and no web access or share links
Devices need to be on at the same time to sync
setupSteps: Open the web interface and add your other device by its ID
Choose a folder to share between them
Keep a separate backup (e.g. an external drive)
